Xena returns to a village she once conquered in order to keep a magical stone out of evil hands, and while there, sees her 9-year-old son.
When the three Fates allow Xena to travel back in time to her pre-warrior days, she attempts to lead a life devoid of violence.
When Gabrielle defends a young Israelite named David, her life is threatened until Xena proposes to fight her old friend Goliath in return for freedom
